title: Genshin Delight
description: this adds 4 new genshin food items for minecraft
body:
This is my mod for minecraft that ads 4 genshin food items and the one unique item minecraft.
I add the Yummy Yum Cha, Chicken Mushroom Skewer, Sweet Madame, and Teyvat's Fried Egg these are the genshin items. The unique item is the LEEK. All of the food item heal you and the unique item both heals, gives haste, strength and fire resistance
